landing.heroSubtitle: Sync your VTC timetable with one paste, keep watch on the 80% attendance line, and carry your schedule in every calendar app you use.
landing.routeTitle: Six stops to a smarter semester
landing.routeSubtitle: Everything the app does, laid out like the line you ride every day.

sync.title: One-paste Moodle sync
sync.desc: Paste your VTC mobile link once — your full academic year imports with live per-semester progress.

attendance.title: The 80% line, watched
attendance.desc: Per-course attendance rates with safe, recoverable, and failed states — plus a calculator that tells you how many classes you can still skip.

calendar.title: A calendar that feels right
calendar.desc: Week, day, month, and agenda views with a semester filter and color-coded course lines.

deadlines.title: Moodle deadlines on board
deadlines.desc: Assignment due dates appear on your calendar with a red flag and one-tap links back to Moodle.

export.title: Take it anywhere
export.desc: Export .ics files per semester, or subscribe once and stay in sync with Apple, Google, and Outlook calendars.

week.title: Week at a glance
